turns.text: What's our revenue and margin by year?

csvChecks.ask: revenue_margin_by_year.csv with columns year,net_revenue_gbp,costed_revenue_gbp,cost_gbp,gross_profit_gbp,gm_pct: one row per calendar year (2009, 2010, 2011); net_revenue_gbp is all product net revenue, costed_revenue_gbp the revenue your margin is worked out on, cost_gbp its cost of goods, gm_pct in %
